title: Special Road Fund, Motor Vehicle User's Charge (Mvuc) As Per R.A. 11239 Preventive Maintenance, Jct Pulauan Port RD
description: CONVERGENCE AND SPECIAL SUPPORT PROGRAM SPECIAL ROAD FUND - MOTOR VEHICLE USER'S CHARGE (MVUC) AS PER R.A. 11239 PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE - SECONDARY ROADS - JCT PULAUAN PORT RD - K1827 + (-319) - K1827 + 000, K1828 + 010.70 - K1828 + 562
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Ed1son Development & Construction Inc.: 1 of 138 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 6 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.
